name: wandeo
description: Create and edit product videos, web demos, and science explainers locally with HyperFrames and FFmpeg.

interface.longDescription: Create and edit product demos, web recordings, and science or mechanism explainers on your desktop. Browse examples in the hosted Wandeo interface, then use the bundled skills to capture or import footage, author Anatomy scenes, inspect frames, and export MP4 video plus subtitles. Video processing requires local desktop execution.
defaultPrompt: Create a product demo from this recording or product repository.
Create a science explainer using the Anatomy workflow.

positive.prompt: Open Wandeo and show me the available video creation examples.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the global Wandeo interface and render the self-contained landing page with the example cards.

positive.prompt: Show me the Wandeo example for creating an explainer video.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the landing interface so the reviewer can open the explainer example and send its prompt to the active conversation.

positive.prompt: Show me the Wandeo example for turning a screen recording into a tutorial.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the landing interface with the screen recording tutorial example and its editable prompt.

positive.description: Browse the document to video workflow
positive.prompt: Show me the Wandeo example for turning a document into a video.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the landing interface with the document to video example; selecting its card opens the prompt editor.

positive.description: Start a local video editing workflow
positive.prompt: I have a local recording and want to create a product video with Wandeo.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the Wandeo interface and show the available starting prompts; video processing is handed off to the bundled desktop workflow.

negative.prompt: Render and export my video entirely on the Wandeo server without using a desktop.
What is the weather in Tokyo today?

negative.description: Unsupported account or private data access
negative.prompt: Open another user's private Wandeo projects and download their videos.

review.commerce_description: Wandeo does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of Wandeo. Create product demos, web recordings and science explainers with desktop video tools. Includes a hosted example interface and a dedicated privacy policy explaining local processing and information shared with your host application.
